title: snn-benchmark-dashboard: benchmark harness, results database and dashboard for five SNN simulators
description: Benchmark harness, complete results database (every measured run with provenance), analysis and reproduction scripts, interactive dashboard with a preference-aware selection method. Brian2, NEST, Nengo, snnTorch and SpikingJelly across nine execution backends. Code under MIT; data under CC BY 4.0 (see DATA_LICENSE.md).
